name: jem-ai-cartoon-animation-studio

scripts.originals:verify: npm run originals:test && npm run originals:qa

scripts.factory:film: node factory/cli.mjs --idea "Friends save the garden after the storm" --theme garden --output ./originals-output --seconds 60
